name: ccache
description: Ccache is a compiler cache. It speeds up recompilation by caching previous compilations and detecting when the same compilation is being done again.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release  \
      -D ENABLE_TESTING=OFF         \
      -D REDIS_STORAGE_BACKEND=OFF  \
      -D HTTP_STORAGE_BACKEND=OFF   \
      -G Ninja .
package:
for compiler in cc c++ gcc g++ clang clang++; do
    ln -sf ../../bin/ccache $DESTDIR/usr/libexec/ccache/$compiler
done
